title: Induction Head Origins of SLAM-ASR Speech Recognition Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.24721v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: What makes a small trained map from encoder states to the embedding space of a frozen language model sufficient for competitive speech recognition? The premise of the SLAM-ASR architecture is that a frozen language model possesses linguistic knowledge rich enough to perform the recognition task. This assumption, while reasonable, provides little insight into the mechanisms underlying these models. We therefore seek the concrete internal structures on which they rely. This work shows that SLAM-ASR models rely on induction heads of the frozen language model: the same heads that copy repeated token sequences in text are also important for mapping speech embeddings to transcript tokens. Moreover, we find pairs of heads that behave as a constrained form of differential attention, cancelling attention noise and sharpening attention onto the previously generated word. Finally, we show how induction heads could be used to improve transcription q

translated_title: SLAM-ASR语音识别模型的归纳头起源
translated_abstract: 是什么使得一个从编码器状态到冻结语言模型嵌入空间的小型训练映射，足以实现具有竞争力的语音识别？SLAM-ASR架构的前提假设是，冻结的语言模型拥有足够丰富的语言学知识来完成识别任务。这一假设虽然合理，却对这些模型背后的机制缺乏深入洞察。因此，我们致力于寻找这些模型所依赖的具体内部结构。这项工作表明，SLAM-ASR模型依赖于冻结语言模型中的归纳头：那些在文本中复制重复标记序列的注意力头，同样对将语音嵌入映射为转录标记起着关键作用。此外，我们还发现了一些注意力头对，它们以一种受限形式的差分注意力运作，能够消除注意力噪声，并将注意力锐化聚焦于先前生成的单词上。最后，我们展示了如何利用归纳头来提升转录质量。
tldr: 本研究揭示SLAM-ASR语音识别模型的核心机制在于冻结语言模型的归纳头——文本中复制重复标记序列的注意力头同样负责语音嵌入到转录标记的映射，且注意力头对以受限差分注意力形式协同降噪。
en_tdlr: This work reveals that SLAM-ASR speech recognition models rely on the frozen language model's induction heads—the same heads that copy repeated token sequences in text—to map speech embeddings to transcript tokens, with head pairs functioning as constrained differential attention.
